title: Advisor tool returns 400 when a Claude Fable 5.2 or Mythos 5.2 executor uses any other advisor model
symptoms: 400 error from a request using the advisor tool after switching the executor to claude-fable-5-2 or claude-mythos-5-2
Advisor model such as Opus 5.5 that worked with the previous executor is rejected
cause: A Fable 5.2 or Mythos 5.2 executor accepts only Fable 5.2 or Mythos 5.2 as its advisor. Other advisor models are rejected.
fix: Set the advisor's model to claude-fable-5-2 or claude-mythos-5-2 when moving the executor to those models.
apply: Set the advisor tool's "model" to "claude-fable-5-2" when the executor is claude-fable-5-2.
affected: Advisor tool (beta) with claude-fable-5-2 or claude-mythos-5-2 executors, from November 9, 2026
